import java.io.PrintWriter
import java.util.Scanner

const val MD = 998244353

fun power(a: Int, k: Int): Long {
    if (k == 0) return 1
    val p = power(a, k shr 1)
    var res = p * p % MD
    if ((k and 1) == 1) res = res * a % MD
    return res
}

fun main() {
    val sc = Scanner(System.`in`)
    val out = PrintWriter(System.out)

    val n = sc.nextInt()
    val k_ = sc.nextLong()

    if (k_ >= n) {
        out.println(0)
        out.flush()
        return
    }

    val c = n - k_.toInt()
    val size = n + n
    val ff = IntArray(size)
    val gg = IntArray(size)

    var f = 1
    for (i in 0 until size) {
        ff[i] = f
        gg[i] = power(f, MD - 2).toInt()
        f = (f.toLong() * (i + 1) % MD).toInt()
    }

    fun ch(n: Int, k: Int): Long {
        if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0
        return ff[n].toLong() * gg[k] % MD * gg[n - k] % MD
    }

    var ans = 0L
    for (a in 1..c) {
        val x = power(a, n) * ch(c, a) % MD
        ans += if ((c - a) % 2 == 0) x else -x
    }

    ans %= MD
    if (ans < 0) ans += MD

    ans = ans * ch(n, c) % MD
    if (k_ > 0) ans = ans * 2 % MD

    out.println(ans)
    out.flush()
}

Two rooks attack each other if they share the same row or column, and there are no other rooks between them.
